# Prefect

> > Prefect is a Python-based workflow orchestration platform for building, scheduling, and monitoring data pipelines, ML workflows, and AI infrastructure with both cloud-managed and self-hosted deployment options.

Prefect provides workflow automation tools for data engineers and ML teams, featuring Prefect Cloud (managed platform), Customer-Managed deployments on Kubernetes, and integrations with technologies like PostgreSQL, Redis, and MCP. The platform supports event-driven workflows and hybrid execution models with enterprise-grade compliance.

## Key Topics

- Prefect Cloud
- Python workflow orchestration
- Workflow automation
- Data pipelines
- Machine learning workflows
- Kubernetes deployment
- Customer-managed Prefect
- Event-driven workflows
- MCP integration
- PostgreSQL and Redis
- Hybrid execution
- SOC 2 compliance
- Prefect 3.0
- Orchestration engine
